language.title: Interface language
language.desc: Applies immediately. Preference is stored in your browser.

preset.title: Quick setup · one-click apply
preset.desc: Paste a single API key to fill in default text / image / video / audio services and reset each agent's default models. Existing services with the same name will be overwritten.

services.title: Service Access
services.desc: Manage the four AI service types: text, image, video and audio. Save and test connectivity in one click — catch configuration issues before a generation fails.
services.emptyDesc: Use "Quick setup" above to fill everything in at once, or click "Add service" to add one manually

toast.presetApplied: Applied text/image/video/audio services and default agent models
toast.promptReset: Prompt reset to default — click Save to apply

agents.title: Agent Advanced Configuration
agents.desc: Adjust each agent's prompts and runtime parameters. Changes take effect immediately after saving. Service access is managed centrally by the platform — no need to configure it here.

skills.desc: Skills serve as an advanced prompt layer for agents and do not affect regular workbench features.
skills.descPlaceholder: Briefly describe what this skill is for
skills.emptyDesc: Click "Add skill" in the top right to create your first prompt file

backups.title: Data & Backup
backups.desc: The database is backed up automatically on every startup and on a daily 24-hour cycle (10 copies kept by default). To restore: stop the server, replace data/huobao_drama.db with the backup file, then start it again.
backups.cardDesc: Uses better-sqlite3 online consistent backup, safe to run while the service is up; the oldest backups beyond the limit are cleaned up automatically.
backups.emptyDesc: Click "Back up now" above to create the first backup
